Confira esta oportunidade para Sitecore Engineering Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Digital Experience Engineering Manager Brazil/Argentina (Remote) Long Term ContractDescription: Step into a pivotal leadership role as a Digital Experience Engineering Manager, where you'll guide a team of talented Sitecore developers and web technology experts to deliver innovative and scalable digital solutions. Your influence will shape the future of our web platforms, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and security. In this dynamic position, you'll have the opportunity to drive technological excellence, mentor a high-performing team, and play a key role in transforming business goals into cutting-edge digital experiences. If you are passionate about leading teams, driving innovation, and making a tangible impact, we invite you to lead with us and propel our digital capabilities to new heights. If you are excited to make a difference applying cutting-edge technologies to solve real business challenges and add value to a global, market-leading organization, please come join us!Key Interfaces: Internal: NA Marketing VP, NA Marketing Brands and Product Teams, NA D&A Product Managers;
Legal Team, DTS Cloud Team;
DTS Enterprise Architecture Team;
NA DTS Team. External: Marketing Agencies, Third Party Providers.Responsibilities: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and web technology professionals, fostering a high-performance culture. Oversee the design, development, and deployment of high-quality, scalable web solutions that align with business strategies and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, product managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of web projects. Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures. Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions. Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope. Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation. Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work. Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements. Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards. Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements. Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges. Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices. Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership. Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.Required Skills and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management. 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development. Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team. Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment. Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development. Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls. Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings. Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers. Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity. Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As anAccount Manager for Brazil, you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.Specifically, your role will involve:Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor. Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services. Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions. Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts. Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions. Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts. Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments. Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management. Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.The ideal profileWe're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions. Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth. Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process First Interview:A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role's requirements. Second Interview:A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Final Step:A proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youRemote Work Environment:Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.Js) | Integração
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Node.Js) | Integração em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.

Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.Js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow's commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil's agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.

You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow's platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.

This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow's presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil's grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.

Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.

Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.

Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.

Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.

Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.

Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.

Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior .Net Developer

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.G., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow's commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil's agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow's platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.What You'll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow's presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil's grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.What You'll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Qué Aportarás Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Deseable Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español.Por Qué Regrow Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.
